source.recording: Böhm, Ackermann & Weinzierl 2020, JAES 68(12) 977-984, doi:10.17743/jaes.2020.0056; data depositonce eacae473-68e1-48fa-8137-3c2cd30919f0 (CC BY 4.0), movement1/2/4.zip excerpts
source.calibration: SPL at 1 m in the microphone direction = dBFS + 143.8 - mic gain - artistic gain (paper section 1.5, Table 3)
source.score: first edition full score, Vienna: S. A. Steiner, plate 2570 [1816/17], Beethoven-Haus Bonn C 93/30 (digital archive); readings to be confirmed by the owner (not in the repository)
source.rule_d: Weinzierl et al. 2018 database v3, 3_Audio_Features.csv "SoundPower in dB" (_et_ files), median over pitches per instrument; ppp = pp, fff = ff, 7 equal steps (real_range.py)
source.directivity: TU Berlin 1a_DirectivitiesSingleTones_SOFA (32 mics), broadband DI over the 32 directions per instrument (modern instruments; timpani)

method.steady: per note >= 0.30 s: energy mean from 100 ms after onset to 50 ms before end, dB SPL at 1 m
method.peak: per note >= 60 ms: loudest 50 ms, dB SPL at 1 m
method.pitch: YIN, 10 ms frames; a note ends at a 0.6 semitone change or 45 dB under the track 99th percentile

power_note: L_W = SPL(1 m) + 10 lg(4 pi) (= 10.99 dB) - DI; DI in the recording direction unknown: see directivity_index_range
position_note: steady median as sound power with the median DI, placed on rule D's scale of the instrument (0 = TU pp = ppp, 7 = TU ff = fff; pp 1, p 2, mp 3, mf 4, f 5, ff 6); the DI range moves it by (DI range) x 7 / span
